items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We told Mr. Wilder Alexander, we told John Hammond... We wasn't going to leave Walter Page in Kansas City.

ctx.x: You mean the feeling that Walter Page instigated when he played?

You could not get it. I told you he was my father and he was my son. I was the last one to talk to him on the phone when we did the "Sound of Jazz". You was there... This man, this beautiful man, he had the capacity. Without him you never would have got us, because when we were leaving Kansas City to come to New York, his wife says, "No, he cannot go." We told Mr. Wilder Alexander, we told John Hammond, we told the man at the Roseland Ballroom - and the man is still alive and I will take you to him, offer this…
